impl.summary: Implemented a form-provider layer (built-in / Gravity Forms / shortcode) for the contact and application form sections plus a site-wide default in Heartland → Settings → Forms, Gravity Forms styling (.hk9-gf), editor-content rendering on every sections template with a per-page position setting (hk9_sections_layout.content_position: after | before | hide), and block-editor guidance (info notice, always-visible/first section boxes, provider-dependent field toggling). All verified on the local stack: sections-test.php 42/42 PASS (3 new provider/layout checks added, the one changed layout-shape assertion now includes content_position=after), built-in forms unchanged on /contact/ and /online-application/ (a real submission went through the JS path: success panel, submission stored, Mailpit received it; temp record deleted), Gravity provider renders gform_wrapper inside .hk9-gf on a temp contact page (screenshots at 1440/390, computed styles: 48px controls, 2px radius, --hk9-border, muted/50 bg, 14px/500 labels, navy 56px full-width submit, 2px navy focus ring, crimson validation), shortcode provider executes [gravityform …] (only shortcode tags survive sanitizing; unknown shortcode / missing GF form fall back to the built-in form), settings default switch (forms.provider=gravity) flips both real pages to GF and reverts cleanly, editor content on /about/ verified for after/before/hide (content.css enqueued only when shown; page restored byte-identical), axe PASS on /contact/, /tmp-gf-contact/, /online-application/ at 390+1440, debug.log empty. Temp page, GF test form and temp fixtures deleted.

issues: Section-level gravity_form_id is stored as a numeric string ('1'), not an int: the field framework's select type (the only type with a dynamic options picker) stores strings and adding a new Fields type was outside my area; helpers cast to int and the settings-level ids ARE ints. Documented in ARCHITECTURE §5/§10.

Files outside the listed AREA that I had to touch minimally: src/Sections/Layout.php + Panel.php (content_position schema/sanitize + the panel select — explicitly requested), src/Settings/Schema.php (the three new settings keys; no extension hook exists), assets/js/sections.js (3 lines so the block editor mirrors content_position). I did not edit Plugin.php: FormProviders boots from Forms\Handler::register() and EditorGuidance from Admin\Notices::register().

Design decision: when the chosen provider cannot render (GF inactive, form missing/inactive, empty/unregistered shortcode) the theme renders the built-in form plus an editor-only note (users with edit_pages) rather than an empty column; documented in the admin guide.

The GF form list (GFAPI::get_forms) is only fetched in admin/ajax/REST/CLI contexts (it loads every form's meta); the frontend validates the single stored id with GFAPI::get_form. Settings pickers fetch the list only on the Heartland → Settings screen.

Revision diffs (RevisionGuard formatter in Sections/Registry.php, outside my area) still print only order/hidden for hk9_sections_layout; content_position is stored/restored correctly but not shown in the diff text.

Plugin-less theme fallbacks for hk9_form_provider()/hk9_render_form_provider() were lint-checked and mirror the plugin logic but were not exercised live (deactivating the plugin would have disturbed the other agent's import runs).
The local site was reset/re-imported by the other agent three times during verification; every check was re-run after content returned, and the temporary page was recreated each time.
impl.integration_notes: Nothing bumped (per instructions). Global helpers added by the plugin (all function_exists-guarded, with theme fallbacks in inc/sections.php): hk9_form_providers(), hk9_form_provider($section,$role) → {provider, role, gravity_form_id:int, shortcode, source, available, notice}, hk9_render_form_provider($resolved,$args), hk9_form_provider_notice($resolved), hk9_gravity_forms_active(), hk9_gravity_forms_list(), hk9_sanitize_form_shortcode(). Theme helpers: hk9_editor_content_position($post_id,$template) ('after'|'before'|'hide'|'' for native-content templates landing/application/thank-you/gallery/default or empty canvas), hk9_the_editor_content(), hk9_template_has_native_content(); hk9_render_sections()/hk9_rec_render_sections()/contact.php inject the card; inc/assets.php adds the content bundle when the card shows. New filters: hk9/forms/provider, hk9/theme/native_content_templates, hk9/theme/editor_content_position, hk9/sections/native_content_templates. Layout meta shape is now {order, hidden, content_position} (default 'after'; old {order,hidden} values sanitize to it). New settings keys forms.provider ('builtin'), forms.gravity_contact_form (0), forms.gravity_application_form (0) — the theme's inc/defaults.php has no entries for them (hk9_theme_option falls back to the explicit defaults passed by the fallback helpers). CSS: assets/src/scss/_gravity-forms.scss is imported by forms.scss (forms bundle, loaded on contact/application templates); .hk9-editor-content styles live in _layout.scss (core) with a :has() rule in _pages-shared.scss; dist/forms.css and dist/theme.css were rebuilt with tools/build-css.mjs. Gravity Forms remains optional and unbundled (every call guarded).

review.verdict: APPROVE (no blocking defects). Provider layer, GF fallback, schema and layout handling all verified live; only low-severity polish items remain.

findings.issue: A registered shortcode that renders nothing (e.g. an enclosing shortcode whose inner content the sanitizer strips: '[caption]x[/caption]' → '[caption] [/caption]', resolve() available=true, render() returns '') silently falls back to the built-in form with no editor note, because the notice is only set for unregistered tags/missing GF forms.
findings.fix: In the theme parts, when `! empty( $hk9_provider['available'] ) && '' === $hk9_provider_html && 'builtin' !== $hk9_provider['provider']`, set `$hk9_provider['notice']` to an 'The [tag] shortcode produced no output; the built-in form is shown instead.' string before calling hk9_form_provider_notice() (or have FormProviders::render() flag it via a by-ref/second return).

findings.issue: `gravity_form_options( int $current = 0 )` is invoked from the options_callback with no argument (Field::options() passes $field), so the 'keep the stored id as an option while unavailable' branch is dead. With GF active, saving a page whose form was trashed/deleted makes Select::sanitize() reset gravity_form_id to '' (value not in options) — silent loss; the code comment claims otherwise.
findings.fix: Either accept the silent reset and delete the misleading comment/branch, or make the options_callback read the current value (e.g. `static function ( array $field ) { return gravity_form_options( (int) ( $field['_current'] ?? 0 ) ); }` if the framework can pass it) / drop the Select-type option validation for this field by keeping `options_callback` returning the stored id merged in.

findings.issue: `FormProviders::gravity_help()` is evaluated eagerly when definitions load, so (a) every admin/REST/CLI request that normalizes definitions calls `GFAPI::get_forms()` (once per request, but on init for all admin pages), and (b) the REST schema `description` of gravity_form_id on the frontend reads 'Gravity Forms is active but has no forms yet' regardless of reality (list is empty outside admin).
findings.fix: Use a static help string ('Shown when the provider is Gravity Forms…') in the field definition and print the active/no-forms status separately in the panel (e.g. via the section `description` or an admin-only inline note), so no GFAPI call happens at definition load.

findings.issue:
Emptiness is judged by `trim( post_content )`; a canvas holding only an empty paragraph block (`

`) renders an empty `.hk9-editor-content--flow` section with 4rem/5rem padding (visible blank band) and enqueues content.css. Same limitation as the pre-existing hk9_the_content_card(), so consistent, but now it affects every sections template.
findings.fix: Add a shared helper `hk9_content_is_blank( $post_id )` that returns true when `trim( wp_strip_all_tags( get_post_field('post_content') ) ) === ''` and the content has no non-paragraph blocks (`parse_blocks()` filter on blockName), and use it in both hk9_editor_content_position() and hk9_the_content_card().

findings.issue: Revision diffs for hk9_sections_layout print only order/hidden; content_position changes are stored/restored but invisible in the diff (implementer disclosed).
findings.fix: Append `Editor content: <label>` to the layout formatter output using Layout::content_labels().

rest_validate_value_from_schema(defaults) = true for contact/form, application/form and Layout::empty_value(); gravity_form_id schema is plain string (no enum, so stored ids always validate), provider enum [inherit,builtin,gravity,shortcode]; sanitize 'GRAVITY'→inherit, '007'→'7', '999' validates.
Shortcode sanitizer:

Precedence matrix (settings provider=gravity, id 7): section builtin+id3 → builtin; inherit+id3 → gravity id3 (section id overrides); inherit → gravity 7; gravity+'' → 7 from settings; bogus → settings. Application role with no settings id → available=false with notice.

CSS: dist/forms.css has 0 gform/gfield/ginput selectors outside .hk9-gf; only top-level selectors in _gravity-forms.scss are .hk9-form-provider and .hk9-gf; --hk9-primary-rgb token exists; .hk9-editor-content--overlap + .hk9-overlap spacing rule present for the 'before' case on contact/about.

i18n: all strings in new/changed plugin files use 'heartland-k9s-core', theme files 'heartland-k9s'; editor notice strings pass through wp_json_encode; Renderer emits data-hk9-key so the provider toggle JS targets exist.
No section template-part uses setup_postdata/the_post(), so the_content() in the 'after' editor-content slot cannot pick up a leaked nested-loop post.
